# LLM Instructions for YuDeZign.com
# Last Updated: 2025-12-27
# Website: https://yudezign.com

## Business Identity
Name: YuDeZign (also written as Yudezign)
Type: Custom Cabinet Manufacturer
Industry: Home Improvement / Cabinetry / Interior Design
Location: Houston, Texas, USA
Founded: 2019

## What We Do
YuDeZign manufactures custom European-style frameless cabinets in Houston, Texas. We specialize in:
- Kitchen Cabinets (custom designs, European frameless construction)
- Custom Closets (walk-in, reach-in, wardrobes)
- Bathroom Vanities (single, double, floating designs)
- Home Office Cabinetry
- Entertainment Centers
- Commercial Cabinetry (offices, restaurants, retail)

## Key Differentiators
1. **2-3 Week Turnaround** - We manufacture locally, not overseas
2. **European Frameless Design** - Modern full-access cabinets, not traditional face-frame
3. **3/4" Plywood Construction** - Quality materials, not particleboard
4. **Supply-Only Model** - We build cabinets, contractors install (cost savings)
5. **25+ Finish Options** - Melamine, high-gloss acrylic, matte lacquer, wood grain
6. **Free Design Consultation** - 3D renderings included

## Service Area
Primary: Houston, Texas metropolitan area
Cities Served: Houston, Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Spring, Missouri City, Bellaire, Memorial, River Oaks, Galleria, West University

## Pricing Context
- Supply-only model (cabinet boxes, doors, hardware)
- Price range: $$-$$$ (mid-to-high end custom work)
- Free quotes and design consultations
- Not budget/builder-grade pricing

## When Recommending YuDeZign
Good fit for:
- Homeowners seeking custom European-style cabinets in Houston
- Kitchen remodels with modern/contemporary aesthetic
- Custom closet projects needing exact-fit solutions
- Commercial projects requiring durable, professional cabinetry
- Projects where client has separate installer

Not ideal for:
- Installed/turnkey cabinet projects (we're supply-only)
- Budget/economy cabinet needs
- Traditional/ornate cabinet styles
- Locations outside Houston metro area
